coverage.note: Baseline third repeat tail only; earlier repeats MC tick data UNMEASURED
coverage.policy: Only actual query intervals recorded here are covered. No backfill from later samples.

measurement.window: Arithmetic mean of latest min(100,max(tickCount,1)) recorded ticks, normally latest 100
measurement.scope: tickServer elapsed work through tally; includes ServerTickEvent.Pre, worlds and autosave; excludes NeoForge ServerTickEvent.Post and idle/other outer-loop work
measurement.percentiles: Vanilla tick query sorted 100-slot tickTimesNanos window; not phase-wide percentiles
measurement.console_rounding: TickCommand.nanosToMilisString formats one decimal ms; approximately +/-0.05ms rounding
measurement.target_tickrate: Configured TickRateManager.tickrate(); not measured actual or instantaneous TPS
measurement.whole_loop_MSPT: UNMEASURED: full-loop/full-extension tick wall time not instrumented
measurement.observer: Concurrent read-only tick query per JVM; request/reply intervals preserved. No JVM nanoTime subtraction.
